name: Debug Tools
author: Verdite3
description: Noclip flight with a cinematic camera, invincibility, infinite MP, enemies that ignore you, a speed multiplier, position bookmarks, warp to any of the game's 28 areas, an editor for the character -- experience, level, HP/MP, gold, the six base attributes, the five condition timers and the equipment-derived ratings -- an inventory and equipment editor, the spell book, and a live readout of the player state the port has identified so far. A dockable panel plus hotkeys; everything is off until you turn it on.
